published.source: DPS report 2026-10-28 (full re-sim at 20,000 iterations, 180 s, after the launch-realm hunter hotfix)

summary: Keeps Battle Shout up for its party, with the raid's Battle Shout off.
rotation: Start with no Rage; Bloodrage and Battle Shout 3s before the pull, then Battle Stance, Charge for 15 Rage and back to Berserker Stance
Sunder Armor as the first GCD after the pull (every warrior; the tanks keep it up after)
Battle Shout again with 35s of it left (about 142s in, before the execute phase), unless it lasts the fight (Forever's lasts 3 min)

Death Wish held for the last 33s when that costs no use, then Recklessness with the fight's last Death Wish (in fights with two, the first goes at the pull without it), ahead of the trinket (which goes one GCD later)

Blood Fury and Berserking with Death Wish (also at the end of the fight), Elune's Light on cooldown but never during Recklessness or in the 15s before it; trinket on cooldown, its last use held for the last 30s; Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 20s
Execute in the execute phase, after Bloodthirst and Whirlwind (Execute first loses 4.7 on Fury and 22.7 on two-hand Fury)
Heroic Strike queued from 80 Rage (in the execute phase too)
Hamstring filler from 10 Rage (procs Windfury Totem and Flurry)
caveats: Assumed: white hits give Rage by weapon speed, at the level 30 rate at every level.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is white hits only, and Heroic Strike counts for Unbridled Wrath.
One +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 15.1.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece not counted. It would add 10.8 vs Humanoids.
Holding Death Wish for 33s: +13.3 at 180s, +26.2 at 120s; the trinket for 30s: +2.2 at 180s.
Second Mighty Rage Potion held for the last 20s: +10.4 at 180s, 0.0 at 120s.
Raid damage hits (2 a minute, about 9 Rage each) are an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec fury -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_fury -apl level60_fury_battle_shout -talents 30305013002-25053005142010501 -race Orc -duration 180, then the raid's battleShout removed (standards 23: the duty preset's own shout is the only one). Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts.
